prompt.en: Which province has a time zone all to itself?
prompt.fr: Quelle province possède son propre fuseau horaire?

explanation.en: Newfoundland and Labrador keeps a time zone of its own. Clocks there are set apart from the rest of the country.
explanation.fr: Terre-Neuve-et-Labrador a son propre fuseau horaire. Les horloges y sont réglées à part de celles du reste du pays.

source.quote: Newfoundland and Labrador is the most easterly point in North America and has its own time zone.

verification.evidence: Newfoundland and Labrador Newfoundland and Labrador is the most easterly point in North America and has its own time zone.
